'''MB450 [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]]''' were manufactured by [[Lydree/Legends|Lydree]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] owned a set of MB450s that he used to observe a group of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] following his hunt for [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].
